minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the 64 Arbor Street plan at owner's request and backed a public market bylaw for town meeting.
minutes.summary: A short Planning Board meeting: the only new business, an ANR plan for 64 Arbor Street, was continued to February 28 at the owner's request. Members approved prior minutes, heard committee reports (stormwater task force, open space, capital planning, Passios building committee), and director updates on the warrant, the water supply protection district and a cannabis bylaw. Members voiced support for bringing a public market general law acceptance to town meeting and put it on the Feb 28 agenda.

Chair again asked for public comment near the end; none appeared.

decisions.decision: The 64 Arbor Street ANR plan is continued to February 28 on the owner's emailed request, with his statutory time limit extended; no motion needed since it is not a hearing.
The public market general law acceptance will be a discussion topic at the February 28 meeting, with the agricultural commission member sending information to the director.
No meeting on February 14; the next meeting is the 28th, and the next few meetings will be held remotely.
The stormwater task force plans to expand by two members (two people expressed interest).
